blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — Local authorities intercepted 150 undocumented live hogs worth P1.3 million in Getafe town as part of Bohol province’s campaign against the spread of African swine fever (ASF). The confiscation also provided a much-needed boost to Bohol’s ongoing efforts to recover from the impact of ASF on its local hog industry, as the provincial government works to repopulate the province’s swine sector. In an advisory, the provincial government said the shipment was traced to have originated from Dumanjug, Cebu. Authorities are also verifying reports that the shipment came from Negros.
